findings.title: Advertising or attribution SDKs, but no consent mechanism found
findings.summary: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) and Adjust are present. No consent SDK (CMP), no code that writes IAB TCF consent keys and no app call to their consent controls was found. A custom or server-driven consent screen is possible; whether consent is obtained before this code runs needs a runtime check (TDDDG §25).

findings.title: SDK code that can read a device identifier, and no consent mechanism found
findings.summary: Adjust contains code that can read the advertising ID (through reflection), reachable from app start-up. A custom or server-driven consent screen is possible; whether consent is obtained before this code runs needs a runtime check (TDDDG §25).

findings.title: Code that can read non-resettable device identifiers
findings.summary: Braze contains code that can read ANDROID_ID. One more site (IMEI or device ID, unattributed code) is left out because the required permission is not declared. Google recommends resettable identifiers for tracking.

findings.title: SDK data collection left at its documented default (on)
findings.summary: Firebase Crashlytics documents automatic collection of crash reports; firebase_crashlytics_collection_enabled is not set.

findings.title: App contains code that can pass data to an analytics SDK
findings.summary: App code contains a call to FirebaseAnalytics.setUserId. Check which value it can pass.
